summary: Verified the /api/analyze bug fix (wrong Groq model id -> qwen/qwen3.8-27b), credit refund on failure, admin Groq-key CRUD, and dashboard UI regression. 8/8 backend tests pass; all UI checks pass. Groq was AVAILABLE during this run so a real chart image produced a successful 200 analysis - the old generic 500 'Failed to analyze the chart' caused by the wrong model id is gone.

minor.issue: Very small/non-chart images cause Zod schema-parse failure -> generic 500 'Failed to analyze the chart. Please try again.' This branch (route.ts:484) is technically correct behavior, but the error message is identical to the old model-id bug message, so users cannot distinguish. Consider a more specific message like 'Could not read the chart from the image, please upload a clearer screenshot.'
AI SDK Warning in logs: '"image" content part is deprecated. Use a "file" part with mediaType: image/*' - non-blocking but should be migrated.

The two FALLBACK_KEYS shipped in /app/frontend/lib/server/groq-keys.ts (lines 25-27) are BOTH now invalid (Groq returns 401 invalid_api_key). If the DB list is ever empty, analyze will fail with an auth error. Consider removing dead fallback keys or updating them.

Frontend error log shows lingering ConnectTimeoutError to 'sweetex-ai-default-rtdb.asia-southeast1.firebasedatabase.app' - looks like a leftover from the old Firebase project. Current app is functionally fine (coco-ai-c363d works) but this suggests stale config or a fallback pointing at the old RTDB.

issues: Header shows 'Sweetex AI / Admin Portal' instead of 'Coco AI' - leftover branding from previous project.
Daily quota cards show 35/day for Standard tier, but review request states standard = 50/day per tool. Possible tier config drift - please confirm intended limit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The BUG FIX for chart analyze is confirmed working. Model id qwen/qwen3.8-27b works when Groq is available; a real chart-shaped image returns 200. The generic-500 path can still be reached with garbage/tiny images (Zod parse fail) - if user reports 'Failed to analyze the chart. To test analyze use a >=~200px candlestick-like image (see /app/backend/tests/test_coco_ai.py::_tiny_png_b64 - uses PIL to draw fake candles).
rca of the issue: Root cause was MODEL_ID = 'qwen/qwen3.6-27b' in /app/frontend/app/api/analyze/route.ts which returned Groq 404 model_not_found; every request fell through to the outer catch and returned a generic 500. Fix: changed to 'qwen/qwen3.8-27b' (the only vision model on this Groq account). Verified end-to-end by POSTing a 400x200 synthetic candlestick PNG with a valid Firebase ID token and getting HTTP 200 with a full analysis JSON. Credit accounting also verified via GET /api/admin/users usageToday before/after.
